images.filename: Welsh Dragon at Welsh Memorial Park Ieper (Ypres) Parc Coffa'r Cymry, Gwlad Belg 01.jpg
images.caption:
Welsh Memorial Park Ieper (Ypres), around a mile from Artillery Wood Cemetry; tribute to men from Wales killed during the Second World War.
It is in two parts: the Park itself, with cromlech and Welsh Dragon and nearby memorial stones to Hedd Wyn, by the side of the road, where he was killed in the Battle of Pilckem Ridge.
